name: Team 1 Table and Plot Agent
description: Extract tables by caption from uploaded Markdown, plot chosen columns from table artifacts or uploaded CSV/TSV, and list available tables. Parsing is deterministic; semantic matching never invents data.

skills.name: Team 1: extract a captioned table
skills.description: Find the table described by the user in an uploaded Markdown document and publish it as a CSV table artifact with exact headers and values.
skills.usage_notes: Use for extracting a table from a .md upload, including caption descriptions. Pass document_artifact_id and the natural-language table_query. For a request to extract AND plot, call this first, then pass the returned artifact_id to team1_plot_table; do not ask for a CSV first. Never use this for CSV uploads.
skills.output_format: JSON with artifact_id, table_artifact_id, caption, columns, numeric_columns and row_count; emits a text/csv table artifact.

document_artifact_id.description: Uploaded Markdown document artifact ID in this conversation.

table_query.description: User description of the wanted table by subject or caption; preserve their wording.

skills.name: Team 1: search DeepLynx
skills.description: Search the configured DeepLynx project for records by name, description, or indexed properties and return the actual matching records.
skills.usage_notes: Use when the user asks to find a document or record in DeepLynx, such as an almanac. Pass the user's search wording as query. Do not claim that DeepLynx is unavailable when this skill is registered; report its actual result or configuration error.
skills.output_format: JSON with matching DeepLynx records and a cataloged JSON artifact_id.

query.description: Text to search for in the configured DeepLynx project. Preserve the user's terms.

page_size.description: Maximum number of matching records to return.

skills.name: Team 1: import a DeepLynx file
skills.description: Expose a DeepLynx file record as a conversation-scoped artifact that downstream table and plot skills can read.
skills.usage_notes: Use after team1_search_deeplynx when a result includes file_id. Pass that numeric file_id; do not pass the DeepLynx record ID as a conversation artifact_id. Then pass the returned artifact_id to team1_list_tables or team1_extract_table.
skills.output_format: JSON with conversation artifact_id, deeplynx_file_id, name, mime_type and size_bytes.

deeplynx_file_id.description: DeepLynx file/record ID from team1_search_deeplynx results.

skills.name: Team 1: plot tabular data
skills.description: Render a PNG plot from an extracted table artifact or an uploaded CSV/TSV. Match requested column names and ask with actual column dropdowns when unspecified.
skills.usage_notes: Use directly for CSV/TSV uploads. For Markdown, use team1_extract_table first and pass its artifact_id here. Supply exact x_column and y_columns when known, or put the original user plot request in plot_query. Leave axes absent for vague requests such as plot this; the skill loads the file and asks dropdown questions offering its real columns. Do not guess axes or fill all numeric columns for an unspecified plot. Use y_columns for multiple series such as each village. Never pass file contents as parameters.
skills.output_format: JSON with PNG artifact_id, selected x_column/y_columns, chart_type, rows, missing_values and x_rows_omitted; emits an image/png artifact.

table_artifact_id.description: CSV/TSV upload or table artifact ID returned by extraction.

plot_query.description: Original natural-language plotting request, including the desired series and axes. For plot this, pass that wording and leave axes absent.

x_column.description: Requested x-axis column or semantic name, only if explicitly specified by the user.

y_columns.description: Requested numeric y-axis column names; may contain several series. Only fill when requested.

y_column.description: One numeric y-axis column; used when answering the agent dropdown.

chart_type.description: Optional style. Auto selects line for time, scatter for numeric comparisons, or bar for categories.

title.description: Optional title explicitly requested by the user; otherwise use the table caption.

skills.name: Team 1: list document tables
skills.description: List actual captions, column names and row counts for every table in an uploaded Markdown file.
skills.usage_notes: Use when the user asks what tables are available or needs help choosing a table; does not plot or invent data.
skills.output_format: JSON listing captions, columns, rows and source_line.
